column1: Rules the Workbench applies when it routes an approval.

column2: The limit is set on the borrower's principal outstanding, or on fair market value for assets held for sale
A limit that depends on collateral value needs a fair market value appraisal by an independent valuer within the last year
Where a level has two rows, the approval is within limit if either row is met
A second delay of legal action or of an auction goes one level up
New credit to a problem loan takes the higher of the restructuring authority and the credit authority in the credit approval regulation
A write-off for a director, senior executive, major shareholder or related party goes to the Board
Hire purchase, auto and unsecured loans follow chapter 8 of the credit approval regulation รบ.-กส.450032 as amended by กกค.690085. Those limits load when supplied (DL18)
A decision that no limit covers goes to the next level up, and an incident records the missing limit
A decision keeps the matrix version it was approved under
A person may not approve a decision they proposed or prepared
Each limit is a row in the delegation limit table with a version, valid from and valid to dates and the approver of the change. A change is a data load approved by Risk
